overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused scholarly and professional social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content centers on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases (CooRnet), and research funding/hiring announcements. Across all platforms, posts achieve strong interaction rates, with academic announcements and tool updates driving particularly high engagement.

contentThemes.description: Posts focused on detecting information operations, coordinated link sharing, and conference presentations on computational methods.
Announcements of open-source software updates like CooRnet v2.0 and newly published research papers.
Sharing major team milestones such as new research grants and hiring opportunities for PhD students and postdocs.

recommendations: Cross-post successful recruitment and grant announcements to Mastodon to leverage its highly engaged academic community.
Include direct links to publications, software repositories, and application forms across all posts to turn engagement into direct traffic.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn, as its larger audience base yields high raw engagement for major career and research milestones.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest engagement rate per post (avg ~6.14%), with strong repost/amplification numbers around research paper publications and opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche but engaged academic audience (~4.55% avg engagement rate) particularly responsive to open-source software releases like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850 followers) generating the highest total volume of likes and comments, especially for major professional news like research grants and job openings.
